title: helm(private): validate values schema, add init hook and upgrade/rollback compatibility
author: Samuel Park
description: Motivation: Private deployments require stronger schema validation for values and safer upgrade/rollback semantics. This PR introduces a values.schema.json for the private Helm chart, adds an initJob hook to perform PVC/secrets bootstrap, and implements a pre-upgrade helm hook that validates migration compatibility to reduce failed upgrades and problematic rollbacks. The change also tightens templating around kmsKeyConfig, node tolerations, and CRD version checks to support zero-downtime upgrades and safe rollback paths. Changes include a new helm-unittest step and schema lint in CI and an integration upgrade-rollback test. Checklist: - Add values.schema.json and wire into CI - Implement charts/private/templates/init-job.yaml as a pre-install hook to create bootstrap resources - Add charts/private/templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-hook.yaml to validate CRDs and migration state - Templating fixes: kmsKeyConfig optional fields, tolerations, affinity blocks - Add upgrade-rollback integration test in charts/private/tests/upgrade-rollback-test.yaml - Update README with upgrade/rollback notes - Ensure Helm hooks use proper annotations and failurePolicy=fail Breaking change: no. Backwards compatibility: templates use conservative defaults; CRD version checks will fallback to supported versions when possible. Testing: local helm unittest, CI lint, integration upgrade-rollback pipeline run against a test VPC cluster. Linear/PM refs: ENG-4123, PM-987. See commits and review conversation for details.
